target.scope: protected-state context reconstruction, activation snapshot reference validation, and fail-closed recovery semantics

goal: Establish the Single-Agent OPN Atom baseline by producing a read-only, evidence-bound capability review for Agent context reconstruction.
observed_flow: Read the handoff, claim, activation, execution, and evidence records from one captured state head.
Validate immutable registration and activation references against their pinned project commits and SHA-256 digests.
Re-read the state head and reconstruct a completed snapshot only when the head is stable and canonical records are valid.
Return an explainable blocked snapshot with side_effects_executed=false when required records are missing, bindings conflict, or the state changes during reconstruction.
contracts_and_invariants: Context reconstruction reads a bounded protected-state record set and does not execute side effects.
The state head must remain unchanged across reconstruction.
A handoff, matching claim, and activation snapshot reference are required for a completed context.
Pinned registration and activation references must exist and match their recorded SHA-256 digests.
Branch and worktree details are projected as null in context output to avoid treating execution metadata as canonical state.
facts: The module emits status=blocked with a machine-readable validation.errors array for invalid context.
The public report builder validates the canonical agent-context-capability-review.v1 schema.
The agent-local deterministic gate passed while this report was generated.
inferences: The capability is a suitable read-only baseline fixture for one enrolled Agent returning context and evidence to a Human responsibility center.
The current contract supports explainable stop and Human Review Handoff, but does not yet demonstrate a multi-node Directed Task Graph.
unverified: Provider-neutral StateStore behavior outside the current protected Git state implementation.
Cross-device relay, node enrollment, and Workbuddy execution interoperability.
Human acceptance, revision, recovery, or rejection of this specific report.

context_tests.description: Deterministic reconstruction and state-head blocked-state tests.

activation_snapshot_tests.description: Activation snapshot reference validation and conflict tests.

execution_context_tests.description: Execution readiness and activation-ref preflight tests.

agent_local_gate.description: Build plus deterministic agent-local verification gate.

failure_or_blocked_cases.condition: The handoff has no activation snapshot reference.
failure_or_blocked_cases.observed_behavior: Reconstruction blocks with reason=activation-ref-missing and no side effects.

failure_or_blocked_cases.condition: The protected state branch changes between the initial and final head reads.
failure_or_blocked_cases.observed_behavior: Reconstruction blocks with state_head_stable=false and reason=state-head-changed.

failure_or_blocked_cases.condition: The claim does not bind to the requested handoff.
failure_or_blocked_cases.observed_behavior: Agent-local lifecycle recording blocks and reports side_effects_executed=false.

risks_and_unknowns: The report is a read-only capability review, not proof of end-to-end OPN coordination.
The report does not prove resource isolation for external repositories or multi-node execution.
The Human responsibility center must review this handoff before the baseline is accepted.

verification_results.summary: No whitespace errors were detected in the working tree.

recommended_next_action: Human reviews the facts, inferences, unverified items, and blocked cases.
Human accepts or requests revision of this baseline report.
If accepted, design the next tracer slice for two explicit execution nodes only after the resource-isolation plan is recorded.

human_decision.rationale: Accepted as the Single-Agent OPN Atom baseline conformance fixture within the stated read-only scope and boundaries.
